nom: Olay Super Serum - Glow Serum for Face - Activated Niacinamide

segments.oily: One reviewer with previously oily areas on her face says the serum balanced her oil production, leaving her skin noticeably less oily, hydrated, smooth and supple.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one whose foundation looked bad over dryness even with a moisturizer, report the constant dry texture and dehydrated look improved and skin feels soft rather than dry.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers who describe sensitive skin report no adverse reaction and good hydration, including one on a dermatological acne treatment and one usually sensitive to strong scents; one dissenting review reports instant burning, itchy red blotches and eye sensitivity that did not resolve after a week and a half of use.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s to 70s report firmer, plumper skin with visibly reduced fine lines, wrinkles and smile lines after consistent use of a few weeks to a few months, including a 66-year-old whose husband spontaneously noticed her fine lines had improved and a 73-year-old who says it replaced more expensive products.

concerns.aging: Most reviewers targeting fine lines and wrinkles report visible smoothing, plumping and firmer-looking skin within one to several weeks, including several in their 50s, 60s and 70s and one whose husband noticed unprompted; dissent includes a 65-year-old who says she saw no results despite months of consistent use, and another who noticed no difference after a while, comparing it to ordinary lotion.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers report noticeably more hydrated, plump and supple skin, including one managing perimenopause-related dryness and another whose dehydrated look and under-eye bags improved within days; two dissenting reviews say they saw no real difference despite weeks to months of consistent use.
concerns.redness: A couple of reviewers report visibly reduced redness, including one who says her rosacea became almost unnoticeable after a week; one dissenting review describes itchy red blotches appearing across the face along with burning, which did not resolve after a week and a half.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer with a seborrhea patch near her eye reports no burning, stinging or flaking after use, and another says the serum does not cause flaking; one dissenting review describes an allergic-type reaction with rough, tight, uncomfortable skin texture, which she attributes to the fragrance.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports her age and sun spots looked half as dark after starting the serum, and another says under-eye bags and a dehydrated look improved within days.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers report calmer skin and fewer blemishes within about a week of use, including one whose acne calmed down and another who says it helped stop recurring pimples when paired with washing in cool water; no reviewer in this set reports new breakouts caused by the serum.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with previously oily areas on her face says the serum balanced her oil production, leaving her skin noticeably less oily and more even.

aspects.libelle: Leaves a subtle shimmery glow on skin
Bottles sometimes arrive underfilled or tampered
Requires daytime sunscreen due to AHA/retinol
Replaces several separate serums, good value

extraits.texte: I bought the Day and Night versions I ended up giving away a half container of the day version (I went back to my original pink Oil of Olay for daytime) and kept using the Night Repair Olay Super Serum religiously because I was desperately seeking results to no avail. Nope I’m sorry I don’t see anything like all these reviews say. Maybe if you never used anything before then started using this you saw results but I’ve been using or tried EVERYTHING Oil of Olay has put out and I always go back to the regular pink bottle combined with the Oil of Olay Regenerist Serum. This new overpriced “Super” serums feel and smell nice going on but that’s all the results I received. I’m 65 and kind of a skin fanatic and it really irks me to see anyone using the wrong product because the ads and commercials using 20 year old models with baby butt skin tell us we can get skin just like hers if we buy this product. I’m sorry but I had to speak up. There’s some great OTC facial creams and serums from $10 to $100+ I know I’ve bought most of them but always go back to basics and I get a lot of compliments on my skin. Be careful with your money ladies.

extraits.titre: Burns and makes skin itchy and red!
extraits.texte: I really wanted to love this product smh. First thing that caught my eye was the luminous color in the product. It is also fragrant. That made me nervous. I’ve used Olay products before and never experienced the discomfort I felt with this particular one. Instant burning! Throughout the day my eyes became super sensitive and itchy as well. My face had red blotches that were super itchy. Tried for a week and a half to give it a chance but I can’t use it anymore. So sad I spent $ on this and can’t tolerate it. I definitely don’t recommend this for sensitive skin. Unfortunately I will not be purchasing again.

I was really excited to use this because I have no issues with the retinol cream in the purple tub. But I believe due to the fragrance or something it made my skin texture rough, uncomfortable, and tight. Too bad… I’ll stick to my previous routine.

extraits.titre: I’m fond of products with Niacinamide👍⭐️
extraits.texte: I have become very fond of serums with Niacinamide. The Olay Super Serum has balanced the oil on my face. I used to have oiler areas, and now they all are blended. Having my face not be as oily has dramatically changed my skin. It’s hydrated, smooth and supple. HOW I USE: AM & PM 1 - Cleanse my face & use toner. 2 - I apply 4-5 drops of this serum to my face. 3 - LAST, I finish with my usual moisturizer. I find if I want results, I must be consistent and patient. Missing applications slow the benefits of the product on my skin. Olay Super Serum goes well with the other skincare products that are part of my regimen. 🚨🚨 You should always thoroughly dry your skin & hands before applying any serums. Then, ensure the serum has been absorbed into your skin before applying moisturizer. If you don’t use it correctly, you’ll get a sticky, icky feel. EXPIRATION DATE: NONE! I always check for an expiration date before using, ESPECIALLY with health & beauty products. This particular product does not have one, then I do not keep it longer than 12 months after opening. PROPERLY SEALED: ✅ It is important to me how manufacturers seal & ship their products. This item was PROPERLY SEALED, as you can see from the pictures. To me, this means the manufacturer cares about its products.✔️ The PRICE for this serum is in the usual range. It’s exactly as advertised, and works well.

extraits.titre: Made of Excellent Ingredients based in YUKA App.
extraits.texte: I usually buy this in physical store however, since the price are the same either through here in Amazon or physical stores, I decided to buy it here for a hassle free shopping. I love that it was packed so nicely. It arrived on sealed packaging and it is authentic Olay Super Serum that I always buy instores. What I love about this product? I started using it in 2024. I am Asian (Filipina), 36yrs old and is in Texas now. Living in Texas was kinda like Philippines but it gave me itchiness and pimples. I used Ponds often when in Philippines but using it in Texas gives me the results that never ever happened when still in Philippines. Like: redness, easily gets sunburn, dry face, itchy face, oily skin. Later on I scan this Olay Super Serum using the YUKA App. It said this product is made of excellent ingredients and that’s how I started using this product. I started with a trial size then later bought the bigger size. If you have pimples, make sure to wash it with mild cold water. NOT HOT OR LUKEWARM WATER. Then apply this product once or twice daily. When I had a sunburn, I used this product 3x but just light. I then noticed my skin gets hydrated, get cured from itchiness and helped me stop my pimples. I always tried to stop using this but I always end up buying it again. It’s the only product so far that is consistent to take care of my facial needs. The scent smells good too.

It is silky and smooth (not greasy) my skin in about a week hasn't been dry and it's balancing and brightening my skin. Age/sun spots are half the darkness. 40 feels like the new 20 with this product! My skin with moisturizer alone still felt like my face was super dry and my foundation looked horrible. Hopefully I will be able to skip foundation with this product. Pics are before/ after 1 week. I have been using the (advanced snail 92 all in one cream) moisturizer. My skin has a glow , a little firmer, rosacea almost unnoticeable . But it got rid of the constant dry texture. Makeup feels smoother.
